NFC Provisioning

Link a new NFC tag

Follow these steps to provision a blank tag and link it to an animal profile.

1
Prepare blank NFC tag
Use any NTAG213/215/216 compatible tag. Collar, ear tag, or card format all work.
2
Hold tag to phone
Place the blank tag against the back of your phone near the NFC antenna.
3
Write animal record URL
NG Safeguard writes the public verification URL to the tag.
4
Verify the write
Scan the tag again to confirm the URL was written correctly.
5
Tag is ready
Anyone can now tap the tag with any NFC-capable phone and see the animal's public record.

Admin Dashboard

New auction

Create auction

This will be publicly advertised on the marketplace. Animals you add here will also appear on your animals page.

How creating an auction works
  • Fill in the details — title, date, venue and a contact number are required; everything else is optional.
  • Add a promotional banner — the wide image buyers see first on your auction. A good photo makes your sale stand out.
  • Add your animals as "lots" — give each one a photo. Animals with photos are shown first to buyers, so upload an image for every lot you can.
  • Publish — it appears instantly in the public marketplace and is saved to your calendar. Each animal is also added to your records.

Auction details

Drafts stay private until you publish them from your auction house dashboard.

Promotional image

Tap to upload promotional banner

This wide image is the first thing buyers see on your auction. Use a clear, landscape photo (e.g. your best animals or your auction yard).

Lots / animals in this auction

Each animal you add here will automatically appear on your animals page and in the public auction listing. Tip: add a photo for each animal — lots with photos are shown to buyers first.
